projectDescription: An AI-native CLI tool that statically analyzes Express backends, builds a behavioral model of your API, and runs intelligent end-to-end workflow simulations — all from the terminal.
keyFeatures: Zero-execution static analysis — scans Express TypeScript source code via AST parsing without running the server
Behavioral Model generation — produces a versioned .jetic/model.json capturing endpoints, constraints, auth, and data dependencies
AI-powered workflow simulation — automatically chains multi-step user journeys with JWT injection and memory capture
Constraint discovery — extracts business logic rules (min values, enums, conditionals) directly from source code
Deep import resolution — follows controller/service imports up to 2 levels for richer AI analysis context
Jetic Studio dashboard — local dark-mode IDE for visual API exploration, source inspection, and simulation management
Multi-environment support — configure base URLs and variables per environment (dev, staging, prod)
Flexible AI provider support — works with OpenAI and OpenRouter; bring your own model
